item.title: ABC News: How distance and old-fashioned phone calls grew love for Amber and Kirsty
item.description: Amber and Kirsty Sayers-Hunt met in a mining town and Amber stuck to the rules. But then, when she was about to move away, Kirsty made the first move and their love story started.

item.title: ABC News: SpaceX rocket orbits Earth and returns to launch pad in world first
item.description: The successful return of the SpaceX rocket to its launch pad is a breakthrough in the company's decade-long effort to develop a fully reusable rocket.

item.title: ABC News: Carpenter leads Chelsea to victory against Manchester City
item.description: Chelsea have gone top of the WSL with the help of another fine contribution from Ellie Carpenter, who got one over her fellow Matilda, Man City's Mary Fowler.

item.title: ABC News: A slowing economy could mean higher youth unemployment, economist warns
item.description: Australia's youth unemployment rate was 11.1 per cent in September and economists say a slowing economy could mean it rises further in coming months.

item.title: ABC News: Young Victorian voters torn between disillusionment, optimism
item.description: Young voters will play an influential role in the election on November 28, making up nearly half the state's vote.

item.title: ABC News: The Brisbane buildings made from sandstone touched by dinosaurs
item.description: Fossilised footprints belonging to 230-million-year-old dinosaurs have been unearthed in Brisbane, indented into the same sandstone that constructed the city's most recognisable buildings.

item.title: ABC News: Nurse offers 'out of the blue' to have surrogate baby for colleague
item.description: Doctors warned Bec Vallee against pregnancy after she was diagnosed with a kidney disorder. But she's experienced the "incredible blessing" of having two daughters through surrogacy.

item.title: ABC News: Ocean that once covered Flinders Ranges preserved Earth's earliest life
item.description: Ancient sea level changes led to the preservation of some of the Earth's earliest complex life forms, according to new research that mapped the Flinders Ranges.

item.title: ABC News: All Blacks suffer 73-year first in defeat to Wales
item.description: Wales have pulled off one of the greatest wins in their recent history, beating the All Blacks for the first time in 73 years in a Nations Championship boilover.

item.title: ABC News: Philippines wins Eurovision Asia, making history
item.description: Seventy years after Eurovision was conceived as a way to unite a war-torn Europe through music, the competition has embarked on an ambitious new chapter in Asia.

item.title: ABC News: Bondi terror attack hero Ahmed Al Ahmed one year on
item.description: The man who went viral after managing to wrestle a firearm away from a gunman during Australia's deadliest terror attack says he still suffers mentally and physically.

item.title: ABC News: Hoffman delivers best Alpine World Cup finish in 27 years
item.description: Madison Hoffman defies a lowly start position to record Australia's best FIS Alpine World Cup finishing position in 27 years, finishing eighth in the season opener at Levi, Finland.

item.title: ABC News: Questions remain whether Victoria's election is tackling the big issues
item.description: Both the Coalition and Labor argue this election is the most consequential in the Victoria's history, but it's lacking stand-out moments or generation-defining policies.

item.title: ABC News: Open-source AI like 'a Nazi coach', UN-backed anti-terror group says
item.description: A group that aims to prevent the unsafe use of artificial intelligence says open-source AI is like "having a Nazi coach at your disposal, reinforcing your thoughts".

item.title: ABC News: Experts say Australia appears 'willing to tolerate' rheumatic heart disease
item.description: Australia is criticised for being "willing to tolerate" some of the world's highest rates of rheumatic heart disease. Today global health leaders in Perth will endorse a bold plan to eradicate the disease by 2040.

item.title: ABC News: Sex, spies and Silicon Valley: Nvidia scandal highlights risks for big tech
item.description: Chinese economic espionage is in the spotlight after the downfall of Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, and former intelligence officials say the US is not doing enough to combat it.

item.title: ABC News: Albanese is caught between climate ambition and political reality at COP31
item.description: Australia wants to establish itself as a serious global climate player, but its efforts at this week's UN climate change conference expose the contradictions in current climate politics, both internationally and at home.
